lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into approximately four horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots to form a rough grid pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature across the upper flank characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side, indicating a longitudinal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, high-luminance linear feature is visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin region, suggesting an external attachment or anomaly.
